paragraphs.text: Scion is creature type exclusive to Eldrazi tokens. It was introduced alongside Processor in Battle for Zendikar and means "descendant".

Similar to Spawns , Scions are colorless and can be sacrificed to add , and are primarily generated by black and green mana cards. Unlike Spawns, Scions are 1/1 instead of 0/1 and have blue-mana generators rather than red.
Notably Scion of Ugin , Scion of Darkness , Scion of Oona , Scion of Vitu-Ghazi , Scion of the Ur-Dragon , and Teysa, Orzhov Scion do not have the Scion type.
